description.translate: Bring four small cogwheels for the coupling display. We need to compare the surviving gear marks with the drawings. Leave your own working machinery in place; make fresh parts for this job. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The damaged coupling matches Voss's readings. Its job was to carry the test frame's vibration, and the trial exceeded its rated load. The forge accident has an explanation. We must still do the patient work of making the next attempt safe.
